content.title: KiddieLearn signup and parent verification capture
lines: Capture 2026-09-22 build 4.8.1; learner age entry: 9; parent email: parent@example.test
Learner step: enter birth year; no independent age check is performed.
Parent step: one-time link to parent mailbox; link challenge 6 digits, expires after 10 minutes.
Lesson delivery [selected by parent]  Optional research [separate unchecked box]
Session token for parent approval stored with version 4.8.1 and UTC timestamp; parent billing token is matched to the account holder.
Optional research can be switched off in parent settings; the research SDK stops receiving new events immediately.
Analytics SDK: KidsAdNet child-device event stream enabled on the learner home screen.
Request correction and close account buttons are visible in parent settings.
Nominate another adult: planned for November release.
